primitives.name: Air Density Correction
primitives.verbatim_quote: AIR: venue air density 1.2712 kg/m3 measured at Lucas Oil Stadium [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-18/weather-pilot/weather-stadium-pilot.json] -> ball carries measurably differently than a sea-level-standard model assumes ; wind 2.5 km/h qualifies it -> deep-ball and kick distances shift; totals and long-DK props carry the effect, spreads barely 2.
primitives.assumptions: Ball trajectory deviates from standard sea-level aerodynamics due to non-standard air density and wind vector.
primitives.breakdown_regime: At altitudes or pressures significantly divergent from sea level, standard ballistic models fail.

layer2.mapping: Maps atmospheric conditions to kinematic adjustments in ball physics for deep pass and kick distance projections.
layer2.telemetry: Projected deep-ball and kick distance variance relative to baseline.

primitives.name: Availability Shift
primitives.verbatim_quote: AVAILABILITY: Jaylon Carlies (IND) listed OUT [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-18/injuries/espn_nfl_injuries_week6.json] -> unit rotation depth changes at that position -> snap share and pressure/scheme leverage shift toward the opponent's strength 3.
primitives.assumptions: Injury-induced roster shifts alter positional balance and strategic load distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When key players are absent, substitution patterns create predictable tactical vulnerabilities.

layer2.mapping: Relates injury status to expected change in offensive and defensive scheme effectiveness via snap count redistribution.
layer2.telemetry: Change in expected snap share and pressure metrics per injured player.

primitives.name: Kalshi Anchor
primitives.verbatim_quote: MICROSTRUCTURE: Kalshi prints 0.26 on this game [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/kalshi/kalshi-nfl-digest.json] -> an independent Layer-1 anchor exists beside the de-vigged book line -> when the two agree within ~2 points, the prior is solid and L2 signals apply cleanly; divergence would flag a stale book 7.
primitives.assumptions: Kalshi's prediction reflects unbiased market sentiment and serves as a validation signal for book accuracy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Disagreement between Kalshi and book lines suggests mispricing or outdated information.

layer2.mapping: Provides probabilistic confidence measure for book line validity using independent market oracle.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation of Kalshi probability from book line in points.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Trench Funnel primitive unifies six domains—biophysical, cognitive, DFS, environmental, market, and on-field—into a single causal lattice. Each domain contributes a distinct but interlinked variable: air density affects ball dynamics, injuries shift positional balance, Kalshi offers a probabilistic anchor, news influences market perception, DFS data reveals ownership patterns, and tracking data updates real-time performance. These variables form a dynamic system where each update modifies the others, creating a feedback loop. Dualities emerge in how environmental factors (e.g., air density) and cognitive biases (e.g., news framing) interact with mechanical systems (e.g., player tracking). Failure modes include overreliance on static proxies, ignoring temporal drift in player availability, or misinterpreting market sentiment without grounding in fundamental data. The system's robustness depends on maintaining empirical consistency across layers.
